models.label: Kling O3 Reference
models.fullLabel: Kling O3 Standard Reference to Video
models.description: Best default for avatar product ads, UGC product videos, and reference-led creator videos where both avatar and product consistency matter.
models.frontendHint: Recommended for avatar + product UGC ads. Uses O3 reference-to-video for stronger identity and product consistency than older Kling 1.6 routes.
models.durationHelperText: Recommended for 5s, 10s, and 15s avatar product UGC ads. RangManch adds TTS and lipsync separately.

models.label: Kling O3 Standard
models.fullLabel: Kling O3 Standard Reference to Video
models.description: Standard alias for the O3 reference-to-video route used by avatar product ads.
models.frontendHint: Alias route for standard avatar + product UGC ads. Prefer canonical key kling_o3_reference in backend create flow.
models.durationHelperText: Internal alias. Canonical backend model is kling_o3_reference.

models.label: Kling O3 Pro
models.fullLabel: Kling O3 Pro Reference to Video
models.description: Best for higher-quality avatar product ads where stronger reference consistency, cleaner motion, and better product handling are required.
models.frontendHint: Use this for higher-quality avatar + product ads when Standard does not preserve the face or product well enough.
models.durationHelperText: Higher-cost O3 Pro route for 5s, 10s, and 15s avatar product UGC ads.

models.label: Kling O3 4K
models.description: Ultra-premium 4K reference-led video generation for agency, brand, and commercial-grade outputs.
models.frontendHint: Very expensive. Use only for agency or high-value client jobs after Standard/Pro tests are approved.
models.durationHelperText: Agency-only 4K route. Avoid exposing this to normal users until credits/pricing are locked.

models.label: Kling 1.6 Standard Elements
models.description: Fallback/draft route for lower-cost image-to-video generation when O3 reference is not required.
models.frontendHint: Internal fallback for lower-cost testing. Not recommended as the main avatar product route.
models.durationHelperText: Fallback only. Use O3 Standard Reference for production avatar product ads.

models.label: Kling 1.6 Pro Elements
models.description: Fallback high-quality elements route for older reference-based Kling tests.
models.frontendHint: Internal fallback for legacy high-quality Kling element tests.
models.durationHelperText: Legacy fallback only. Use O3 Pro Reference for higher-quality avatar product ads.

models.label: LTX 2.3 I2V
models.description: Best for low-cost image-seeded testing and practical avatar/product video iterations.
models.frontendHint: Use this for affordable image-to-video testing, avatar product experiments, and seeded drafts.
models.durationHelperText: LTX 2.3 image-to-video is currently limited to short seeded clips.

models.label: Sora 2
models.description: Best for polished premium video generation with cinematic motion and strong visual coherence.
models.frontendHint: Use this for premium hero renders, launch films, explainers, and polished campaign videos.

models.label: LTX Benchmark
models.description: Internal benchmark route for stitched cinematic montage testing via self-hosted LTX.
models.durationHelperText: Internal LTX benchmark scene route for 5s to 6s stitched scenes.

models.label: Seedance Lite Reference
models.description: Affordable reference-to-video route for avatar product ads using avatar and product reference images.
models.frontendHint: Budget-friendly option for quick UGC product ads. Lower consistency than premium Kling routes.
models.durationHelperText: Affordable 5s/10s reference video route using avatar + product images.
